category_edits.rationale: For all four dataset models, blend each normalized encoder state with a causal, exponentially recency-weighted mean of observed states: 0.75*h_t + 0.25*p_t, with decay timescale 4. Preserve cumulative observed-position IDs, truncation, HSTU backbone, embeddings, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports HSTURec from train.py, so inference automatically uses the same readout with unchanged checkpoint shapes and final-real-position selection.

states = self.last_norm(seq_emb)
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        states = states.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
        positions = torch.arange(maxlen, device=seq.device)
        distance = positions[:, None] - positions[None, :]
        weights = torch.exp(-distance.clamp_min(0).to(states.dtype) / 4.0)
        weights = weights.masked_fill(distance < 0, 0.0)
        pooled_sum = torch.matmul(weights, states)
        pooled_mass = torch.matmul(weights, valid.to(states.dtype).unsqueeze(-1))
        pooled = pooled_sum / pooled_mass.clamp_min(1e-8)
        readout = 0.75 * states + 0.25 * pooled
        return readout.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)

change_summary: Add causal recency pooling to the shared HSTU state readout, consistently applied during training and generated inference for all four categories.
